sql:
CREATE FUNCTION vol(text) returns text as
  'begin return $1; end' language plpgsql volatile
shape: CREATE FUNCTION vol(text) RETURNS text AS 'begin return $1; end' LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE;

sql:
SELECT CASE
  (CASE vol('bar')
    WHEN 'foo' THEN 'it was foo!'
    WHEN vol(null) THEN 'null input'
    WHEN 'bar' THEN 'it was bar!' END
  )
  WHEN 'it was foo!' THEN 'foo recognized'
  WHEN 'it was bar!' THEN 'bar recognized'
  ELSE 'unrecognized' END
shape: SELECT CASE (CASE vol('bar') WHEN 'foo' THEN 'it was foo!' WHEN vol(NULL) THEN 'null input' WHEN 'bar' THEN 'it was bar!' END) WHEN 'it was foo!' THEN 'foo recognized' WHEN 'it was bar!' THEN 'bar recognized' ELSE 'unrecognized' END;
